E_c11_ss11_crosscheck.verdict: REFUTED on cell 1 (and therefore on Status).
E_c11_ss11_crosscheck.refutation: Cell 1 claims the CEB case is GEOMETRY-COMPLETE. MEASURED: `case 'slab.create'` (CommandEventBridge.ts:618-651) reads `polygon` and never `boundary`, so a `slab.create {boundary}` — a payload `CreateSlabPayload` explicitly accepts at :101 and that PreviewManager.ts:333 actually sends — emits `slab.created` with `polygon: undefined` and NO boundary field at all (probe P-9: `slab.created id=slab_… polygon=undefined boundary=undefined`). The §FT1 guard then returns. The BATCH case does accept both (`s.polygon ?? s.boundary`, :679), which makes the asymmetry an oversight rather than a convention. §11.4 stage 4 ('CEB … emit slab.created with full geometry ✅') carries the same defect.
E_c11_ss11_crosscheck.second_refutation: §11.4 stage 3 marks FIX-SLAB-ZERO-AREA '⚠ → ✅ fixed'. MEASURED (probe P-9): `slab.create` with the plain plan-2D `polygon: [{x,y}]` still refuses — `slab.create: canExecute rejected — boundary has zero area`, because the handler maps `{x,y}` -> `{x, y, z: 0}` (:169) and `signedAreaXZ` reads x/z. What was 'fixed' is the CALLER (SlabPlanToolHandler.ts:438 sends worldZ in BOTH y and z); the convention clash itself is live and is the file's own open TODO (SLAB-BOUNDARY-CONVENTION, C11 §7.4).
E_c11_ss11_crosscheck.column_legend_note: The VDT+bimManager legend ('AFTER LegacyStore.add()') is correct FOR SLAB — initTools:2400/2401 do sit after :2374 add(). It is the WALL and CURTAIN-WALL cells the legend contradicts (both register BEFORE add, §G3-STALE-FIX / §G3-STALE-FIX-CW). Following the legend literally would reintroduce the §G3-STALE-EVENT storm.
